versionReconciliation.action: Use the publisher's exact version 150.547 citation for this snapshot. The OBIS descriptive page still shows 150.540 and is stale relative to the acquired snapshot; do not substitute its older citation.

publicationDecision.disposition: Keep as a local research candidate. A CC0 rights-screen pass does not establish taxon identity, regional or waterbody association, current presence, coordinate safety, freshwater coverage, or publication eligibility.
remainingGates: Review taxon names and identifiers against an explicitly pinned fish taxonomy.
Review source locality and waterbody context against versioned geography; province-name text alone is insufficient.
Review coordinate precision and sensitive-species exposure before any public mapping.
Do not infer current presence because occurrenceStatus is missing for every row in this CAS slice.
Acquire and review separate freshwater sources for rivers, streams, lakes, reservoirs, and wetlands.
